title: Digital IDs Now Work In 20 States
hook: Digital IDs now work in 20 states.
closing: Phone-based identity is spreading, but most travelers still need the plastic backup.
question: Would you trust a digital ID?

segments.say: Digital IDs now work in 20 states. Airport identity checks are moving onto phones.
Digital IDs reached 250 airport checkpoints. Availability expanded from a pilot into a national network.
Digital IDs still cover only 20 states. Most of the country has not adopted them yet.
